subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “People hurry through cities every day, rarely thinking about what lies below.”?
options: The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on layers of earlier footsteps.
It reminded them that institutions are built not only by rules, but by repeated human actions.
A city that ignores toilets may look modern while making daily life harder for many people.
The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「People hurry through cities every day, rarely thinking about what lies below. The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on…」，答案為「The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on layers of earlier footsteps.」。
